title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a worldwide database of reported shark incidents. This site uses a cleaned version of its records to explore where incidents occurred and how they relate to human activities.
Shark attacks can be serious, but they are rare compared with the many people who enter the ocean. Dramatic stories can make rare events feel common, so fear of sharks can loom larger than the risk.
Use the Map page to explore reported attack counts by country. Trends compares fatal and non-fatal records for activities with at least 50 incidents whose outcomes are known. These are counts, not per-person risk rates.
